C0123.title: Huang et al. Exploiting Ad Settlement Loopholes to Defraud Advertising Fees
C0123.summary: The Shanghai Putuo District Court found that Huang, acting with intent to illegally possess, colluded with others to exploit ad settlement loopholes and defraud over 50 million yuan in advertising fees while also selling counterfeit trademark goods. Wu defrauded over 20 million yuan in advertising fees. Wei and eight others participated in selling counterfeit trademark goods. Huang and Wu's action
